bib.title: Qwen-VL: A Versatile Vision-Language Model for Understanding, Localization, Text Reading, and Beyond

question: How can an LLM be given fine-grained visual perception (captioning, VQA, text reading, grounding) in an open model trained in three stages?
hypothesis: Higher input resolution, a position-aware compressing adapter and fine-grained caption-box and OCR data give an open LVLM better grounding and text reading than coarse-grained generalists of similar size.
contributions: Visual receptor: language-aligned ViT plus position-aware cross-attention adapter
Input-output interface with image, box and ref special tokens

method.summary: Qwen-7B LLM, OpenCLIP ViT-bigG encoder and a single-layer cross-attention adapter with 256 learnable queries. Stage 1 trains ViT and adapter on 1.4B cleaned image-text pairs at 224px; stage 2 trains everything on 7 tasks at 448px; stage 3 instruction-tunes LLM and adapter on 350k dialogues to give Qwen-VL-Chat.
method.task: vision-language pretraining and instruction tuning; captioning, VQA, text-oriented VQA, referring expression comprehension

datasets.name: Stage-1 image-text pairs (LAION-en/zh, LAION-COCO, DataComp, Coyo, CC12M, CC3M, SBU, COCO Caption, in-house)
datasets.preprocessing: 8 filters: aspect ratio, small images, CLIP score (dataset-specific), non-English/Chinese characters, emoji, text length, HTML tags, irregular patterns; for CC12M and SBU remove special tags; longest text kept when several match an image

datasets.name: Stage-2 multi-task data
datasets.size: Captioning 19.7M, VQA 3.6M, Grounding 3.5M, Ref Grounding 8.7M, Grounded Cap. 8.7M, OCR 24.8M, Pure-text 7.8M samples
datasets.source: GQA, VGQA, VQAv2, DVQA, OCR-VQA, DocVQA, TextVQA, ChartQA, AI2D, GRIT, Visual Genome, RefCOCO/+/g, SynthDoG-en/zh, Common Crawl pdf and HTML, in-house text
datasets.preprocessing: same-task data packed into sequences of length 2048; GRIT recursive boxes cleaned greedily; synthetic OCR with 41 English and 11 Chinese fonts on COCO backgrounds; PDF/HTML pages rendered via PyMuPDF/Puppeteer and filtered

datasets.name: SFT instruction data
datasets.source: caption/LLM self-instruct dialogue data plus manual annotation, model generation and strategy concatenation; mixed with pure-text dialogue
datasets.preprocessing: ChatML format, 'Picture id:' before each image; only answers and special tokens supervised

datasets.name: Evaluation benchmarks (Table 9)
datasets.split: Nocaps val; Flickr30K karpathy-test; VQAv2 test-dev; OKVQA val; GQA test-balanced; ScienceQA-Img test; VizWiz test-dev; TextVQA val; DocVQA/ChartQA/OCRVQA/AI2D test; RefCOCO/+ val,testA,testB; RefCOCOg val,test; GRIT test

models.name: Qwen-VL
models.architecture: ViT + single-layer cross-attention adapter + decoder LLM
models.init_from: Qwen-7B (an intermediate checkpoint, Appendix E.4), OpenCLIP ViT-bigG

other.adapter_pos: 2D absolute positional encodings added to cross-attention query-key pairs

training.lr_schedule: cosine decay; ViT layer-wise lr decay 0.95 (stages 1, 2), 0 in SFT
training.epochs: one epoch in stage 1 (each image seen once)
training.tokens: stage 1: about 1.5 billion image-text samples and 500 billion image-text tokens

other.frozen: stage 1 freezes the LLM (trains ViT and adapter); stage 2 trains all; SFT freezes the ViT, trains LLM and adapter
other.model_parallelism: none in stage 1, 2 in stages 2 and SFT
other.stage_inits: adapter random in stage 1; stage 2 from stage 1; SFT from stage 2

inference.decoding: greedy search for captions; greedy open-ended generation for VQAv2, OKVQA, GQA, VizWiz; ScienceQA constrained to options, highest-confidence option
inference.prompting: caption prompt 'Descripe the image in English:'; VQA prompt '{question} Answer:'; few-shot exemplars by naive random sampling; SEED-Bench video by sampling four frames

metrics.name: VQA score / EM / ANLS / relaxed EM / accuracy

eval.protocol: single reported number per benchmark, no seeds or significance tests stated

availability.data: in-house data not released; public sources used

evidence.quote: consuming approximately 1.5 billion image-text samples and 500 billion image-text tokens

results.claim: Qwen-VL gets 85.8 CIDEr zero-shot on Flickr30K, above Flamingo-80B.
results.quote: Qwen-VL achieves state-of-the-art performance (i.e., 85.8 CIDEr score) on the Flickr30K karpathy-test split

results.claim: Qwen-VL scores 79.5 / 58.6 / 59.3 on VQAv2 / OKVQA / GQA.
results.quote: On VQAv2, OKVQA and GQA benchmarks, Qwen-VL achieves 79.5, 58.6 and 59.3 accuracy respectively

results.claim: Qwen-VL gets 63.8 on TextVQA, above InstructBLIP at 50.7.
results.table: Table 5, row Qwen-VL (Qwen-7B), column TextVQA (63.8; InstructBLIP 50.7)

results.claim: Qwen-VL-7B gets 89.36 on RefCOCO val, above Shikra-13B 87.83 and below UNINEXT-H 92.64.
results.table: Table 6, row Qwen-VL-7B, column RefCOCO val (89.36)

results.claim: Qwen-VL-Chat scores 1487.58 on MME perception and 360.71 on cognition.
results.table: Table 7, row Qwen-VL-Chat, columns MME Perception 1487.58, Cognition 360.71

results.claim: Qwen-VL-Chat scores 645.2 on TouchStone English and 401.2 on Chinese.
results.table: Table 7, row Qwen-VL-Chat, column TouchStone En 645.2, Cn 401.2

results.claim: Qwen-VL MMLU is 50.7 against 49.9 for the intermediate Qwen-7B used for initialisation, so multimodal training did not erode text ability.
results.setup: MMLU, Qwen-VL after stage 2 vs intermediate Qwen-7B checkpoint
results.note: Final released Qwen-7B scores 58.2; the comparison is to an earlier checkpoint.
results.table: Table 11, row Qwen-VL, column MMLU (50.7); row Qwen-7B (intermediate) 49.9

results.claim: Window attention gave clearly higher loss than global attention in the ViT, with similar speed at 448px (9 vs 10 s/iter), so global attention was kept.
results.table: Table 10, rows 448x448 Global 10s / iter and Window 9s / iter

results.claim: Stage 1 consumed about 1.5 billion samples in 50,000 steps at batch size 30720.
results.quote: The training process uses a batch size of 30720 for the image-text pairs, and the entire first stage of pre-training lasts for 50,000 steps

limits: Compute, hardware and wall-clock not stated; no seeds or significance tests.
In-house data (220M pairs and text corpora) not released and its details are not given.
Adapter-query and window-attention ablations use a ViT-L/14 or are shown only as loss curves, not benchmark scores.
Stage 1 has no VQA data yet zero-shot VQA rises, noted without analysis.
Authors name speech/video, scaling and image generation as future work.
LLM start is an intermediate Qwen-7B checkpoint, not the released one.

lineage.note: grounding data and format followed with minor modifications
lineage.quote: We follow Kosmos-2 to use the GRIT (Peng et al., 2023) dataset for the grounding task with minor modifications.
